decisions.title: Set Odinforce goals before entering a path
decisions.text: Odin has pre-fight choices and can develop Odinforce through eligible knockdowns, but the most useful setup depends on the encounter. Pick the fight that needs each option rather than spending a limited pre-fight benefit without planning.

decisions.title: Use SP1 True Strike against the right defender
decisions.text: SP1 can offer True Strike and Bulwark under the relevant Odinforce condition. Check that Odinforce is active and that the defender has an avoidance or Auto-Block interaction the utility can actually answer.

decisions.title: Count unique buffs before SP2 cash-out
decisions.text: SP2 can gain value from several distinct personal buffs while Odinforce is active. Track which buffs remain, and beware of Nullify or buff-punishing nodes that can disrupt a planned damage window.

decisions.title: Reduce spell cooldowns without rushing unsafe combos
decisions.text: Pixie can shorten spell cooldowns using specific Light attacks. Check the spell timer and defender movement rather than forcing an extra attack solely to complete the countdown.

decisions.title: Gain Wisps when the spell trigger is actually eligible
decisions.text: Her Heavy and anti-Evade spell options can build Wisps under the right conditions. Verify that the defender presents the trigger you want and that there is a safe opening for the cast.

decisions.title: Use SP2 conversion before follow-up Prowess expires
decisions.text: SP2 can convert a developed Wisp resource, while SP1 can benefit from the remaining Prowess window. Watch the duration and opponent power before attempting the second Special.

decisions.title: Charge Channeling only when spacing is controlled
decisions.text: Professor X can build Channeling through safe Heavy charges and SP1 interactions. A long Heavy startup against a prepared defender is not a reliable option; create a recovery opening first.

decisions.title: Convert Channeling with the appropriate cancel
decisions.text: Movement and block cancels can influence his Prowess resources. Check the active state after a cancellation before launching the next Special, rather than assuming every backdash refreshes the intended effect.

decisions.title: Attempt Mind Control chains with enough resources
decisions.text: Maximum Channeling can enable Mind Control and a Special-attack sequence. Monitor remaining power and duration, because that resource state does not guarantee unlimited chained Specials in every matchup.
